name: Garantiwebt AI – AI Content Generator (Claude, OpenAI & Gemini)
author: garantiwebtasarim

sections.description:
Garantiwebt AI is an AI content generator for WordPress. Turn a single keyword into a complete, SEO-optimized article — structured with H2/H3 headings, internal links and a featured image — powered by Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI GPT-4, or Google Gemini.

Whether you need a one-off blog post or hundreds of articles in bulk, Garantiwebt AI writes ready-to-publish content in 36 languages, right inside your WordPress dashboard — no copy-pasting from external AI tools.

Key Features

  • Multiple AI Providers — Choose between Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI GPT-4, and Google Gemini
  • SEO-Optimized Content — Automatically structured with H2/H3 headings and optimal keyword placement
  • 36 Content Languages — Generate articles in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, and 31 more
  • 14 Admin Languages — Plugin interface in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
  • Automatic Featured Images — Optional Pixabay integration adds a relevant image to each article
  • Title Suggestions — AI-powered title recommendations for your keyword
  • Article History — Track every generated article with status and SEO score

What’s Free

The free version is fully functional on its own, with no limit on how many articles you create. Generate complete, SEO-scored articles one at a time, with featured images and your choice of Claude, OpenAI, or Google Gemini. There is no charge for the plugin — you only pay your AI provider for API usage, typically between 1 and 10 cents per article.

Garantiwebt AI Pro

Pro is for users who need high volume and automation:

  • Bulk Production — generate hundreds of articles at once from a keyword list
  • Autonomous Mode & WP-Cron scheduling — set it and let it publish on a schedule
  • AI internal linking engine — automatically interlinks your content
  • SEO Engine — A+ to F scoring with actionable fixes
  • 5 AI Engines — AI Memory Core, Content DNA, ACF Engine AI, Elementor AI, WooCommerce AI
  • Multi-site support & priority support

Learn more and view plans at garantiwebtasarim.com/garantiwebt-ai

How It Works

  1. Enter your API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google in the Settings page
  2. Optionally add a Pixabay API key for automatic featured images
  3. Go to Generate Content and enter a keyword
  4. Select language, tone, word count, and other options
  5. Click “Generate Article” and watch the AI create your content

The article is saved as a WordPress post or page, complete with your selected category, status, and featured image.

Your API Keys Are Safe

All API keys are stored securely in your WordPress database and are never transmitted to our servers. The plugin communicates only with your chosen AI provider and (optionally) Pixabay for images.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services. Please review their terms and privacy policies before use.

Anthropic Claude API

Used to generate article content when Claude is selected as the AI provider.
Data sent: article keyword, language, tone, word count, and optional site context.
Sent when: user clicks “Generate Article” or runs Bulk Production.
Service: https://anthropic.com
Terms of Use: https://www.anthropic.com/news/updates-to-our-consumer-terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

OpenAI API

Used to generate article content when OpenAI GPT is selected as the AI provider.
Data sent: article keyword, language, tone, word count, and optional site context.
Sent when: user clicks “Generate Article” or runs Bulk Production.
Service: https://openai.com
Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/usage-policies
Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Google Gemini API

Used to generate article content when Gemini is selected as the AI provider.
Data sent: article keyword, language, tone, word count, and optional site context.
Sent when: user clicks “Generate Article” or runs Bulk Production.
Service: https://ai.google.dev
Terms of Use: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Pixabay API

Used to search and download a relevant featured image for generated articles.
Data sent: article keyword and your Pixabay API key.
Sent when: a new article is generated and Pixabay is selected as the image source.
This service is optional. If no API key is provided, no external image request is made.
Service: https://pixabay.com
Terms of Service: https://pixabay.com/service/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://pixabay.com/service/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the garantiwebt-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Garantiwebt AI > Settings and enter your API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google.
  4. Optionally enter a Pixabay API key under Settings > Featured Image for automatic image insertion.
  5. Go to Garantiwebt AI > Generate Content and create your first article.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin really free?

Yes. The single-article generator is free and unlimited — there is no cap on how many articles you can create. SEO scoring, featured images, and all three AI providers are included. You only pay your own AI provider for API usage. Pro is optional and adds bulk production, automation, internal linking, and the AI engines.

Which AI provider gives the best results?

Claude from Anthropic is recommended for the best balance of quality, speed, and cost. GPT-4o is excellent for creative content. Gemini 1.5 Pro is a strong, cost-competitive alternative.

Do I need my own API key?

Yes. Garantiwebt AI uses your own API keys from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google. Your keys are stored securely in your WordPress database and are never sent to our servers.

How much does it cost per article?

The plugin is free. You pay your AI provider separately based on API usage — typically 1 to 10 cents per article depending on the model and word count.

Can I generate content in multiple languages?

Yes. Garantiwebt AI supports 36 content languages on the same WordPress installation.

Does the plugin add featured images automatically?

Yes. When a Pixabay API key is configured, the plugin finds a relevant photo and attaches it as the featured image. Without a key, the article is published without one.

Does it work with Elementor and other page builders?

Yes. Garantiwebt AI creates standard WordPress posts and pages, fully compatible with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and any theme or page builder.

What is the Bulk Production feature?

Bulk Production (Pro) lets you add multiple keywords to a list and generate articles for all of them in a single session with one click.

2.1.0

  • Added Bulk Production feature for generating multiple articles from a keyword list
  • Added SEO analysis and meta description generator (SEO Tools tab)
  • Added internal link engine — AI automatically adds relevant internal links to generated articles
  • Added 36 content language support
  • Added 14 admin panel languages (EN, TR, DE, FR, ES, IT, PT, NL, PL, RU, AR, ZH, JA, KO)
  • Added Pixabay integration for automatic featured images
  • Improved AI prompt for higher quality structured content
  • Improved JSON response parsing for all AI providers
  • Added article history with SEO scores and status tracking
  • Added title suggestion feature

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini API integration
  • Single article generation with SEO scoring
